episodes.taskPrompt: Allow boolean flag options with --no- prefix to be declared before or after their positive counterpart without throwing duplicate option errors.
When excess positional command line arguments are provided, format the error message to list the unexpected argument values.
Support grouping options and subcommands under custom section headers in formatted help text.
Add custom value coercion capability to positional arguments through a parseArg handler.
Allow numeric values starting with a minus sign (such as negative numbers) to be parsed as option or argument values rather than flags.
Ensure output configuration updates return or clone isolated settings so parent command output streams are not mutated by subcommands.
Strip redundant trailing whitespace and empty lines when rendering option descriptions that only contain default value notes.
Support declaring alternative long option flags (such as --dry-run and --dryrun) without requiring a short single-character flag.
Clean up terminal escape code stripping in help width calculations by utilizing native utility helpers.
Ensure formatted command help text correctly balances option padding and term widths across help and command formatters.
Support conditional revalidation handling (such as ETag and If-None-Match headers) when processing HTTP QUERY requests.
When sending chunked transfer responses, prevent setting a redundant Content-Length header if Transfer-Encoding is already present.
Modernize string utility helpers by introducing a safeTrimEnd function that replaces legacy trimRight with standard trimEnd semantics.
In the default error handler, log the full error object or error stack instead of only the error string message.
Allow application view rendering to accept null or undefined as options without throwing an error.
Ensure response MIME type resolution handles extension strings with leading dots and falls back gracefully when MIME lookup fails.
When normalizing content types with normalizeType, fall back to application/octet-stream if the type lookup fails.
In request header parsing, strip leading and trailing whitespace from Content-Type values before extracting media types.
Preserve pre-computed custom ETag headers during response generation even when custom transfer headers are enabled.
Implement safe attachment header generation that properly escapes quotes in content disposition filenames across response and utility modules.
Ensure route decorators preserve custom status_code settings when returning streaming and event-stream responses.
Ensure Server-Sent Events formatting splits multiline data on both carriage return and newline characters to comply with the SSE specification.
Apply response_model filtering and schema validation to endpoint return values when the handler return annotation is typed as Iterable[T].
Correct parameter extraction for query parameters when sequence types contain nested typing.Annotated metadata.
Propagate exclude_defaults and exclude_none recursively to dictionary values when serializing data structures with jsonable_encoder.
Preserve streaming response return annotations and media types when mounting sub-routers via include_router.
Optimize OpenAPI generation by skipping redundant dependency tree traversals for endpoints without security dependencies.
Support automatic directory existence validation when mounting static frontend applications to warn on missing asset paths.
Clear temporary parameter inspection caches after route registration to minimize application memory footprint.
Allow dependency-injected background tasks and response headers to execute during frontend static file responses.
Add execution timeout bounds to Python AST parsing child processes to prevent deadlocks on malformed syntax.
Compute SHA-256 build provenance metadata including tree hash, dirty state, and commit hash during post-build stamping.
Decouple remote LLM processing permissions from local AST indexing and enforce schema training rights filtering.
Support configuring maximum evaluation call limits via SIFTR_JEV_MAX_CALLS and case-insensitive operational mode parsing.
Implement TokenizerRegistry allowing model-specific BPE estimation methods with fallback to conservative character ratio heuristics.
Prevent workspace file modification race conditions by validating workspace snapshot hash before replanning iterations.
Extract symbol character byte offsets alongside line spans in language parsers to support granular code replacement tools.
Annotate dependency graph edges with semantic provenance kinds (import, call, inheritance) to prioritize high-value recall paths.
Implement append-only SQLite observation recording for agent interaction trajectories with automatic database schema migration.
Ensure model ranker classes expose a uniform toArtifact serialization method returning model type, hyperparameters, and tree payload.
